conflicts.fact: Which Day interval had the bean's largest height increase
conflicts.versions: Lesson 6 Observed says bean increased most between Day 21 and 28 (12 cm). This matches the fact sheet data (Day 21 = 18, Day 28 = 30), but the same lesson says bean is steepest between Day 14 and 28. This is a small wording mismatch with the growth-curve fact and would not mislead.
The lessons say Form 3 class (as in the fact sheet) while the task is Grade 11 Biology. All lessons use the same label, so there is no inter-lesson conflict.
